name: companies-house
title: Companies House
description: Search the UK Companies House register — companies, officers, filings and charges.
author: aic

commands.name: search-companies
commands.title: Search Companies
commands.subtitle: Companies House
commands.description: Search for UK companies by name or number.

commands.name: search-officers
commands.title: Search Officers
commands.subtitle: Companies House
commands.description: Search for company officers and directors by name.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your Companies House REST API key. Create a free application key in the developer dashboard.

tools.name: search-companies
tools.title: Search Companies
tools.description: Search UK companies by name or number.

tools.name: get-company
tools.title: Get Company
tools.description: Get a company's full Companies House profile by its company number.

tools.name: get-officers
tools.title: Get Officers
tools.description: List a company's officers (directors, secretaries, members) by company number.

tools.name: search-officers
tools.title: Search Officers
tools.description: Search for company officers and directors by name.

tools.name: get-officer-appointments
tools.title: Get Officer Appointments
tools.description: List all appointments for an officer across companies, by officer id.

tools.name: get-filing-history
tools.title: Get Filing History
tools.description: List a company's recent filings by company number.

tools.name: get-charges
tools.title: Get Charges
tools.description: List charges registered against a company by company number.

tools.name: get-persons-with-significant-control
tools.title: Get Persons with Significant Control
tools.description: List a company's persons with significant control (beneficial owners) by company number. Explains an empty register: a market-listing exemption, a filed statement, or a genuine gap.

tools.name: get-insolvency
tools.title: Get Insolvency
tools.description: Read a company's insolvency record by company number: cases, dates and appointed practitioners. Most companies have none.

tools.name: get-disqualifications
tools.title: Get Disqualifications
tools.description: Search the register of disqualified directors by name. No match is the ordinary result and means nothing is recorded.

ai.instructions: Use these tools to answer questions about UK companies and their officers using Companies House data. A company number is 8 characters (eight digits, or two letters followed by six digits, e.g. OC394454). To look something up, search by name first, then pass the returned company number or officer id to the detail tools. Only an officer's birth month and year are ever available.

evals.input: @companies-house what is the company number for Monzo Bank?
@companies-house who are the current directors of company 09446231?
@companies-house who are the beneficial owners of company OC394454?
